headline: EPS grows across both comparisons
summary_short: Chugoku Marine Paints reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of ¥76.89, up 32.2% q/q and 50.6% y/y.
summary_long: EPS of ¥76.89 rose 32.2% sequentially from ¥58.15 and 50.6% year-over-year from ¥51.06. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
